title: Hyderabad evening card: DCM fatality on NH-44, Vice President as Liberation Day chief guest, CM Old City visit
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
bullets_en: A woman was killed and two injured when a DCM rammed their bike on NH-44, Hyderabad.
The Vice President will be the chief guest of 'Hyderabad Liberation Day'.
CM Revanth Reddy is likely to visit the Old City soon and meet Aga Khan-5.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad mein NH-44 par DCM ne bike ko takkar mar di; ek khatoon halak, do zakhmi.
Vice President 'Hyderabad Liberation Day' ke chief guest honge.
CM Revanth Reddy ke jald Old City daure aur Aga Khan-5 se mulaqat ka imkan hai.
